name: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
description: Near Xi'an in Shaanxi province, this vast tomb complex was built over 38 years for Qin Shi Huang, who first unified China. His burial chamber lies beneath a 76-metre pyramid-shaped mound and remains unopened. Nearby, the famous Terracotta Army stands guard: lifelike soldiers, each with a different face, along with horses, chariots and weapons. Many more figures are likely still buried.
